definitions.absent: no interval, test, decision or population statement
definitions.aggregation: cell-equal mean, minimum and maximum; no other weighting
definitions.arithmetic: exact rationals; every published value a reduced fraction with its binary64 value; no rounding in this document
definitions.monotonicity: monotone in B and w by construction: m is non-increasing in B and in w; that is a property of the formula, not a finding
definitions.not_a_re_execution: not a re-execution: selection from the record only; no regeneration, no rebatching, no target-call cost, no output-invariance claim
definitions.not_b1: not B1's found-nothing rate; B1 searched with an adaptive, secret-guided finder over its own prompt family and is not comparable
definitions.populations: the UNSAFE cells are the analysis set; SAFE cells are listed by identity only, UNKNOWN cells by identity plus their unknown_reason; neither enters a denominator
definitions.quantity: for an UNSAFE cell with w recorded witnesses among its N recorded evaluations, m(w, B) = C(N - w, B) / C(N, B): the probability that a uniformly chosen B-element subset of the cell's recorded evaluations, with their recorded labels and execution contexts held fixed, contains none of the recorded witness indices; B is the number of selected recorded evaluations

not_published: no Monte Carlo, no float approximation, no interval, no test, no population statement
no rate over the 64 cells; no summary that includes a SAFE or UNKNOWN cell in a denominator; no weighting other than cell-equal
no comparison with B1, B2 or A4; no claim about any execution that was not run
